title: Limit of the octahedron recurrence with GUE boundary data
summary: We study the tropical octahedron recurrence on the lattice tetrahedron $\{(x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4)\in\mathbb Z_{\geq0}^4: x_1+x_2+x_3+x_4=n\}$ with an intrinsic double-hive boundary law. Let $M_1^{(n)},M_2^{(n)},M_3^{(n)}$ be independent standard $n\times n$ GUE matrices and, for fixed $\ell_1,\ell_2,\ell_3>0$, set $ X_r^{(n)}=\ell_r\sqrt n\,M_r^{(n)},\qquad r=1,2,3. $ The boundary law on the two upper panels is the Gibbs density on the cone of double hives whose four exterior sides correspond, in the prescribed orientations, to the spectra of $X_1^{(n)},X_2^{(n)},X_3^{(n)}$, and…
